servinfo.title: Fail-Safe Table
servinfo.ptxt: This function is provided by the safe mechanism that assures safe driveability even when the solenoid valve, sensor or its circuit fails. The following table shows the fail-safe function for each fail condition of sensor, solenoid valve or its circuit.

item.ptxt: TCM stops the following control / function.
Gear shifts to 3rd and remains in 3rd when the failure occurs in 1st, 2nd or 3rd gear.
Gear shifts to 5th and remains in 5th when the failure occurs in 4th, 5th or 6th gear.
Gear remains in R range when the failure occurs in R range.

servinfosub.title: Emergency Mode
servinfosub.ptxt: When a DTC is detected, TCM switches the emergency mode status of A/T control between emergency modes 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. The emergency mode is deactivated when the faulty condition is corrected.

topic.title: Emergency mode 1
topic.ptxt: When TCM detects a DTC, emergency mode 1 shifts to step 1.

After that, if the detected DTC is any of P0963, P0967, P0971, P0977, P2721 or P2730, the mode shifts from step 1 to step 2a. If any other DTC is detected and the system recovers from solenoid current cut status in step 1, the mode shifts from step 1 to step 2b. When the vehicle is stopped, the mode shifts from step 2b to step 3.

entry.ptxt: Gear position when trouble is detected.

topic.ptxt: *: Learning control inhibited, Slope shift control inhibited, Garage shift control inhibited, Slip controlled lock-up control inhibited, Lock-up control inhibited, Engine speed control inhibited, Cruise control inhibited, Manual mode control inhibited

topic.title: Emergency mode 2
topic.ptxt: When TCM detects a DTC, emergency mode 2 shifts to step 1. After that, when the vehicle is stopped, the mode shifts from step 1 to step 2.

entry.ptxt: Oil pressure when trouble is detected.
Gear position when trouble is detected.
After solenoid current is cut off, shifts to 3rd if possible.
Shifts to 5th if shifting to 3rd is not possible.
